_comment: Local F5-TTS voice synthesis (zero-shot cloning). No network calls to third-party TTS -- reference clip + transcript only. Output WAVs land in output/audio/ and are served by GET /api/audio/file/<name>.

chunking._comment: F5-TTS generates ~30s max per pass (reference + generated share the window). Chunks are packed at sentence boundaries; callers should send Shorts-length scripts (~30s).

inference._comment: Pinned venv on D: (torch 2.5.0+cu124 -- last wheel with sm_61). The wrapper loads the model once per job and exits, so VRAM is released between jobs; synthesis does not assume MuseTalk is resident. HF weights cache lives on D:.

mock._comment: DEV-ONLY. When true, synthesize() copies the reference clip to the output instead of running the model, so the queue/poll/download path can be exercised with no GPU. NEVER true for real output.
